review_candidates.title: Marketing Strategist
review_candidates.location: Qesm El Sheikh Zaid, Al Jizah, Egypt
review_candidates.description: HABEN MARQUEE is looking for a strategic, analytical, and commercially minded Marketing Strategist to join our team. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in developing marketing strategies, conducting market and competitor research, identifying audience insights, and translating business objectives into actionable marketing plans. Key Responsibilities: Develop integrated marketing, brand, and communication strategies based on client business objectives. Conduct market, competitor, consumer, and industry research to identify opportunities and strategic insights. Develop positioning, value propositions, audience segmentation, and key messaging frameworks. Build strategic marketing plans covering digital, social media, content, campaigns, media, and customer journeys. Prepare strategic presentations, research reports, campaign briefs, and recommendations. Collaborate with creative, content, media buying, account management, and production teams to ensure strategic alignment. Analyze campaign and brand performance and provide recommendations for optimization. Participate in client meetings, workshops, pitches, and strategic presentations. Requirements: 2 - 4 years of experience in marketing strategy, brand strategy, strategic planning, or a related role. Previous experience in the real estate industry is mandatory. Experience working with medical, healthcare, clinics, or aesthetic brands is a strong plus. Strong understanding of Egyptian consumer behavior and market dynamics. Strong capabilities in market research, competitor analysis, positioning, and strategic planning. Ability to translate data and insights into clear and actionable strategies. Excellent presentation, storytelling, and communication skills. Strong command of English and Arabic. Advanced skills in PowerPoint/Google Slides and strategic presentation development. Agency experience is preferred. Creative thinker with a strong commercial mindset and attention to detail.

review_candidates.title: Software Testing Internship
review_candidates.description: Company Description Bayanatz is a consultancy and training firm specializing in digital transformation, with a strong emphasis on machine learning implementations and data governance solutions for organizations of all sizes. In addition, Bayanatz offers software development services, including mobile applications, data management tools, CRMs, and dashboards. Committed to enhancing business operations, Bayanatz aligns its services with the MENA region's digital transformation goals and initiatives. Role Description This is a full-time remote Software Testing Intern role. The intern will be responsible for creating, managing, and executing test cases, as well as assisting with test management and carrying out various testing activities. They will collaborate with the software development team to ensure the quality and functionality of applications. The role provides an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in software testing within a professional and innovative environment. Qualifications Ability to design, write, and implement test cases for software applications Familiarity with test management techniques and tools, as well as test execution processes Basic understanding of software development concepts Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Excellent communication and teamwork abilities Experience with or interest in software quality assurance practices Enrolled in or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field Proactive attitude and willingness to learn in a dynamic and remote work environment

review_candidates.title: Sr Technical Sales Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Description Nass Tech Integrated Projects has been providing advanced engineering solutions across multiple industries since 2004, with a focus on performance, efficiency, and sustainability. The company serves clients in life sciences, FMCG, industrial sectors, and energy, delivering tailored solutions that address specific operational requirements. Nass Tech’s core expertise includes black and clean utilities, process fluid handling solutions, filtration solutions, and instrumentation and control systems. The organization is committed to innovative, reliable solutions that support long-term client success. Following significant growth in the Egyptian market, Nass Tech has expanded its presence to Saudi Arabia. Role Description Establishing new and continuing existing, long-term relationships with customers by contacting and following up with clients to identify new projects.   Providing pre-sales support and organizing sales visits.   Managing and interpreting customer requirements - listening to clients and using smart questioning to understand, anticipate and exceed their needs.   Persuading clients that a product or service will best satisfy their needs in terms of quality, price, and delivery.   Writing periodical sales reports.   Ensuring that sales targets are met.   Giving presentations to help clients discover and understand the company profile and products.   Responsible for analyzing the customer’s needs to fulfill the customer requirements with respect to our product offerings and proposes solutions to the customer to help them to achieve their objectives.   Answering queries, providing technical advice, and demonstrating how to support our customers to meet required engineering standards.   Attending trade exhibitions, conferences, and meetings.   Qualifications B.Sc. degree in (Mechanical or Mechatronics Engineering)   1-3 years of experience in the same field.    Ability to discuss highly technical concepts with prospective leads.   Very Good English Skill level.   Very Good Interpersonal and communication skills.   Engineering knowledge in the industrial sector.   Willing to participate in occasional travel to support the business.   Completion or exemption from military service.   Preferred the residents of Western Parts of Cairo.
